candidates.notes: May describes the Aug 8 Jubilee as extensive, followed by a major fish kill; the most severe mortality was along roughly 6 km of shoreline south of Great Point Clear.
Exceptionally valuable event because May measured DO during the Jubilee in 1.5 m water.
